note: Promotion to the tracked schema (roadmap Phase 1 backfill). Track groups follow the (XX) prefixes already embedded in the source theme names. Empty fields (track, code, level, description) are filled; authored transfer_check values replace ONLY the two known generic placeholder sentences — real source checks are never overwritten (guard in tools/normalize_blocks.py).

themes.description: Reading a real utility or service bill line by line — what is owed, by when, and what happens if it is ignored.
themes.transfer_check: Read one real bill aloud line by line — amount, due date, consequence — and pay it or diarise its payment correctly.

themes.description: Where water and electricity enter the home, how the meter counts them, and shutting either off safely.
themes.transfer_check: Locate the water shutoff and electrical panel in a real dwelling and read both meters, logging the figures.

themes.theme: A room that can be cleaned (HH)
themes.description: The order and method of cleaning a room so it stays clean — surfaces, floors, and the corners that get skipped.
themes.transfer_check: Clean one real room in the taught order and have somebody else verify it against a checklist, corners included.

themes.description: The household repairs anyone can do — a washer, a fuse, a hinge — and recognising the ones that need a professional.
themes.transfer_check: Complete one real household repair — washer, hinge, fuse or equivalent — and state which failures you would not attempt.

themes.description: Sorting, temperatures, dosing and drying so clothes come out clean and last — including washing by hand.
themes.transfer_check: Sort, wash and dry one real mixed load correctly, including one item washed by hand, with nothing shrunk or stained.

themes.description: Reading the early signs of pests and damp, the causes behind them, and the response that stops them spreading.
themes.transfer_check: Inspect a real dwelling for pest and damp signs, identify any cause found, and apply or specify the first remedy.

themes.theme: The household that runs on a list (HH)
themes.description: Shopping lists, chore rotas and the weekly routine — running a household deliberately instead of by crisis.
themes.transfer_check: Run one real week from a written shopping list and chore rota, and report what the lists caught that memory would have missed.

themes.description: The agreements that make shared kitchens, bathrooms and bills workable, and repairing them when they break.
themes.transfer_check: Draft house rules for a real shared space with those who share it, and mediate or rehearse one disagreement under them.

themes.description: The household emergencies — leak, outage, lockout, gas smell — and the first correct move for each.
themes.transfer_check: Given three staged household emergencies — leak, outage, gas smell — perform the correct first move for each.

themes.description: Moving out well: notice, cleaning, meter readings, key handover and getting the deposit back.
themes.transfer_check: Produce a complete move-out file for a real or rehearsed departure: notice letter, meter readings, cleaning checklist, key handover.

themes.description: Tracking a real month of spending until the pattern is visible, and naming the categories honestly.
themes.transfer_check: Track every expense for one real week and present the categorised total with the one pattern that surprised you.

themes.theme: The account, the card and the fee (MY)
themes.description: What a basic account does, what a card actually is, and the fees that quietly take from small balances.
themes.transfer_check: Read a real account's fee schedule and statement, and name every charge taken from it in the last month.

themes.description: Interest as the price of borrowed money — comparing a loan, a card and an informal lender on total cost.
themes.transfer_check: Compute the true total cost of one real or advertised loan against paying cash, showing the interest arithmetic.

themes.description: Checking pay against hours and rate, reading the deductions, and querying a shortfall without drama.
themes.transfer_check: Check one real payslip or payment against hours and agreed rate, and draft the query for any shortfall found.

themes.theme: Saving where you cannot reach it (MY)
themes.description: Why savings survive only when they are separated, and the vehicles — account, lockbox, club — that create distance.
themes.transfer_check: Open or design a separated savings arrangement and make its first deposit, stating the barrier that protects it.

themes.description: The frauds that target ordinary money — prizes, urgent transfers, fake officials — and the checks that defeat them.
themes.transfer_check: Take one real scam message received by you or your family and demonstrate, step by step, the checks that expose it.

themes.description: Cost per use, quality signals and timing — spending more once instead of less repeatedly.
themes.transfer_check: Compare two real purchase options on cost per use and evidence of durability, and defend your choice with figures.

themes.theme: Tax, in the simplest form that is true (MY)
themes.description: What tax is, which ones touch your life, and the difference between avoiding a form and owing a debt.
themes.transfer_check: Identify which taxes touch your own household and correctly read one real tax line on a payslip, receipt or bill.

themes.description: Lending to and borrowing from family and friends with terms said out loud, and what a gift is.
themes.transfer_check: Write a fair one-page note for a real or rehearsed loan between people who trust each other — amount, timing, and what happens if it fails.

themes.theme: Planning for the month that goes wrong (MY)
themes.description: The buffer, the priority order of bills, and who to call first when income stops.
themes.transfer_check: Write your household's bad-month plan: the priority order of bills, the buffer target, and the first two calls made before missing a payment.

themes.description: The identity and qualification papers work requires, where each comes from, and keeping copies that survive.
themes.transfer_check: Assemble your own five work documents — or the plan to obtain each — with safe copies stored in two places.

themes.theme: Filling in a form that decides something (WK)
themes.description: Reading a consequential form fully before writing, answering what is actually asked, and keeping the copy.
themes.transfer_check: Complete one real consequential form fully and correctly on the first pass, keeping the copy.

themes.theme: Writing to somebody who can help (WK)
themes.description: The short, specific letter or message — who you are, what you need, by when — that gets an answer.
themes.transfer_check: Send one real letter or message of request — who you are, what you need, by when — and log the response it got.

themes.description: Researching the role, preparing three stories and two questions, and arriving early in the right clothes.
themes.transfer_check: Complete a mock interview with three prepared stories and two questions, scored by the interviewer against a rubric.

themes.description: Names, rules, where things are and what to ask — the first day handled so the second is easier.
themes.transfer_check: After a real or simulated first day, produce the map: names learned, rules that matter, where things are, and your three questions.

themes.theme: Being paid to do a job well (WK)
themes.description: Reliability, standards and finishing — the working habits that turn a job into a reference.
themes.transfer_check: Hold one real responsibility for two weeks — job, chore contract or role — with reliability logged and a reference obtained.

themes.theme: When something goes wrong at work (WK)
themes.description: Mistakes, conflicts and accidents at work — owning, reporting and repairing them in the right order.
themes.transfer_check: Role-play owning a real-shaped workplace mistake: report it, propose the fix, and follow through in the right order.

themes.description: The minimum wage, hours, breaks and safety rules that apply where you live, and where to turn when they are broken.
themes.transfer_check: Look up the actual minimum wage, break and safety rules where you live, and check one real job against them.

themes.description: Pricing, invoicing, records and tax when you are the business — the paperwork that keeps small work legitimate.
themes.transfer_check: Produce a correct quote, invoice and simple record page for one real or rehearsed piece of paid work.

themes.description: Notice, handover and the reference — ending a job so the door stays open.
themes.transfer_check: Draft a proper notice letter and a one-page handover for a real or rehearsed departure that keeps the reference intact.

tracks.name: Getting things done in the world

themes.theme: Reading a timetable and a map (CM)
themes.description: Planning a real journey from timetable and map alone — connections, walking legs and the margin for error.
themes.transfer_check: Plan and complete a real journey with one connection using only the timetable and map, arriving within your stated margin.

themes.description: The checks and small maintenance that keep a bicycle, motorbike or car dependable, and the costs of neglect.
themes.transfer_check: Perform the full pre-use check on a real bicycle, motorbike or car and correct or report every fault found.

themes.description: Working backwards from an appointment — preparation, travel and buffer — so arriving early becomes ordinary.
themes.transfer_check: Work backwards from a real appointment in writing — preparation, travel, buffer — and arrive early, showing the plan.

themes.description: Booking with a clinic, office or service: the information to have ready, the questions to ask, and the confirmation to keep.
themes.transfer_check: Book one real appointment by phone or portal with the information ready, and keep the confirmation record.

themes.description: Stating your business to an official clearly and calmly — what to bring, what to ask for, and what to write down after.
themes.transfer_check: Conduct one real or role-played official interaction: state your business in two sentences, ask your question, and write the record after.

themes.description: Dates, names, reference numbers and copies — the personal record-keeping that wins disputes months later.
themes.transfer_check: Build a record file for one real ongoing matter — dates, names, reference numbers, copies — complete enough to hand to a stranger.

themes.description: Naming what you need, choosing who to ask, and accepting help in a way that keeps your dignity and theirs.
themes.transfer_check: Make one real, specific request for help — the need named, the person chosen — and report what asking well changed.

themes.theme: Doing something for the first time (CM)
themes.description: The method for any unfamiliar task — find someone who has done it, break it down, do the first small step today.
themes.transfer_check: Take one real unfamiliar task through the method: find someone who has done it, break it down, complete the first step today.

themes.theme: When you are the responsible adult (CM)
themes.description: Being the one in charge of children, elders or a situation — the duties that arrive with the role and the calls you must be ready to make.
themes.transfer_check: Run a rehearsed scenario as the responsible adult — a child, an elder, an incident — making each required call in order.

themes.theme: Teaching somebody else what you learned (CM)
themes.description: Passing on a skill properly — showing, watching them try, and correcting without taking over.
themes.transfer_check: Teach one skill from this pack to another person, hands on their materials, until they perform it without you.

tracks.name: The first minutes of an emergency

themes.description: The look-assess-act habit at any emergency — danger first, then the person, then the call.
themes.transfer_check: Approach three staged emergencies verbalising the sequence — danger, response, call — and act correctly in each.

themes.description: The emergency numbers where you live, what the call-taker will ask, and giving a location that can be found.
themes.transfer_check: Complete a realistic mock emergency call: correct number, the call-taker's questions answered, your location given two ways.

themes.description: Direct pressure, elevation and when a bleed is beyond home control — stopping blood loss with what is in reach.
themes.transfer_check: Control a staged severe bleed with correct direct pressure and escalation, narrating the decision points.

themes.description: Recognising true choking and delivering back blows and thrusts, adapted for infants and adults.
themes.transfer_check: Demonstrate the complete choking response on adult and infant manikins, adapting correctly for each.

themes.description: Cooling a burn long enough, covering it right, and the burns that must be seen by a clinician.
themes.transfer_check: Treat a staged burn with correct cooling time and covering, and state which burns must be seen by a clinician.

themes.description: Checking response and breathing, the recovery position, and staying until help takes over.
themes.transfer_check: Assess a staged collapse — response, breathing — place the person in the recovery position, and maintain monitoring until handover.

themes.description: Escape first, doors closed, smoke low — the household fire response, and the small fire you may fight.
themes.transfer_check: Run your dwelling's escape drill smoke-low with doors closed behind you, and state the one fire you might fight and the ones you never would.

themes.description: The drowning risks around your own area, reach-and-throw rescue, and why swimmers drown trying to help.
themes.transfer_check: Demonstrate reach-and-throw rescue with real materials and name the three drowning risks nearest your own area.

themes.description: Crossing, riding and travelling defensively, and the first-on-scene basics at a road accident.
themes.transfer_check: Assess one real crossing or junction for its risks and walk a staged first-on-scene response — protect, assess, call.

themes.description: The hours after — reporting, records, checking on people, and the reactions in yourself that are normal.
themes.transfer_check: From a staged incident, complete the after-actions: report filed, people checked, record written, and the normal reactions named.
